correctness.rationale: The symmetric product coordinate \(u=x(N-x)\) gives an exact rational objective with positive denominator. Its derivative numerator \(G\) is strictly decreasing for every positive budget and nonnegative inhibition parameter, while its value at the center factorizes into a positive factor times \(12N+8b-N^3\). This proves the unique global cubic threshold, exactly one interior product-coordinate optimizer above threshold and its two symmetric allocation preimages, all local types, endpoint minima and the quartic critical case. Implicit differentiation verifies the onset coefficient; large-budget root expansion yields the stated prescriptions. The standalone code verified the independently evaluated rational identity and exact numeric case and supplements rather than replaces proof.

value.rationale: Substrate inhibition creates a motivated conflict between even distribution of a finite loading budget and retaining each compartment near its preferred substrate. This work gives the complete exact two-compartment global optimizer phase diagram with a unique cubic threshold, the change in critical-point topology, a computable square-root onset law and high-substrate performance separation from equal loading. Those are structural and physically interpretable facts for the smallest natural nonconvex biochemical resource-allocation model, not arbitrary numeric slices or routine reparametrizations. The assumptions limit interpretation to instantaneous fixed-biomass kinetic response.
